stdout:
Manage use-case documents.

Usage: papyrus use-case [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create   Create a use-case document.
  list     List use-case documents.
  view     View a use-case document.
  edit     Edit a use-case document.
  archive  Archive a use-case document.
  delete   Delete a use-case document.
  status   Set the status of a use-case document.
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
